ui.title: eufy recording export
ui.intro: Connect your account to read historical event recordings from your HomeBase 3.
ui.country.hint: Use the account region shown in the eufy app, such as US, CA or CN.
ui.timezone: Times use America/Toronto, including daylight saving time. Your computer and HomeBase 3 must be on the same LAN.
ui.saved.hint: These files are saved on this computer. Times come from the event index; clips may include pre-recorded footage. Event clips do not guarantee coverage of the entire requested interval.
ui.privacy: This page is provided by your local project, not eufy. Passwords and login sessions are held in service memory and cleared when it stops.
ui.disconnected: The local service disconnected. Please restart the project.
ui.unreachable: Cannot connect to the local service. Check that the project is running.
ui.recordings.unreachable: Cannot connect to the recording service.
ui.recordings.unavailable: The recording service is temporarily unavailable.
ui.error.localPage: Please submit from the local sign-in page.
ui.error.credentials: Enter your email, password and two-letter country code.
ui.error.verifyFirst: Sign in first, then enter the verification code.
